# 15 Wire create/destroy/box into render() end to end, finalize demo

## Outcome

`render()` correctly handles `sequenceDiagram` sources combining every feature in the board's
scope — participants/actors, all ten arrow forms, all seven block kinds nested, create/destroy
lifecycle, box grouping, title, and autonumber — with no further changes to `index.ts` itself
(confirms the dispatch from ticket 05 remains generic). `demos/sequence-diagram.html` reaches its
final form, showcasing every in-scope feature in one coherent example.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `render()` on a real `sequenceDiagram` source combining create/destroy participants inside
  and outside of blocks, a box grouping, and every other in-scope feature, mounts a correctly
  structured SVG end to end.
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion listed in `spec.md`'s "Acceptance criteria" section passes when
  exercised through `render()` on real source text (not just at each stage's unit seam) — this
  ticket is the board's final closing verification pass.
- [ ] `demos/sequence-diagram.html`, opened in a browser and built against the real
  `@siren/core` Vite library bundle, visibly renders one comprehensive example exercising every
  feature in scope: `participant`+`actor`, all ten arrows, a self-message, all seven block kinds
  (with at least one nested combination), `create`/`destroy`, `box`, `title`, and `autonumber`.

## Test seam

`render(source: string, container: HTMLElement, options?): SirenRenderResult` — integration test
under jsdom, extending ticket 10's test file to be the board's comprehensive closing test.
